convert_euler_to_quaternion: convert euler angles for roll pitch and yaw in degrees to a MuJoCo quaternion array
multiply_two_quaternions: multiply two quaternion arrays together using the MuJoCo mjlib mju_mulQuat binding
compute_quaternion_velocity: compute the 3D angular velocity vector from a quaternion and a time step dt
negate_quaternion: negate a quaternion array using the MuJoCo mjlib mju_negQuat binding
compute_quaternion_difference: compute the difference between a source and target quaternion by multiplying the negated source with the target
